purpose: Independent practice of D2.1 + D2.2 — predicting outcomes using likelihood.
student_learning_goal: I can use likelihood to predict.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can use likelihood to predict.
header.character_watermark: Lucky Lou the Loon in the top-right corner with a coin. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Predict 4 coin flips. Mark H or T. Then flip a real coin and write the result.
parts.visual_layout: A 2-column 4-row table. Columns: 'Predict' and 'Result'. Each cell has space for H or T.

image_placeholders.description: A 2-column 4-row prediction table for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Header row labels: 'Predict' and 'Result'. 4 prediction rows, each with two ~1.2in × 0.6in cells for writing H or T. Above the table, a small icon of a coin labelled 'COIN' (~0.6in).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P1_COINS at Part 1: instructions ask the child to predict and test coin flips. Keywords name the visual element (coin) and activity (predict).

parts.answer_key: Any predictions accepted. Result column should be filled with actual flip outcomes (H or T). Predictions and results may differ — both are valid.

parts.student_instructions: Look at the bag: 4 RED marbles + 1 BLUE. Predict 3 pulls. Tell why your prediction is most likely.
parts.visual_layout: Top: a bag illustration with 4 red and 1 blue marbles visible. Below: 3 prediction lines with a 'why' line.

image_placeholders.description: An illustration of a marble bag for a Grade 1 worksheet. The bag is open showing 4 red marbles and 1 blue marble inside. Each marble ~0.5in. Below the bag, 3 numbered prediction lines and a single 'because' line for the reason.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P2_BAG at Part 2: instructions ask the child to predict marble pulls. Keywords name the visual elements (marbles, bag, red, blue).

parts.answer_key: Most predictions = RED (more likely, 4 of 5). Reason should mention 'more red marbles' or 'red is more likely'.

parts.student_instructions: Make 2 predictions about today: one POSSIBLE, one CERTAIN.
parts.visual_layout: Two prediction lines stacked. Line 1: 'POSSIBLE: ___'. Line 2: 'CERTAIN: ___'.

image_placeholders.description: Two prediction lines for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Line 1: 'POSSIBLE: ___' (~5in long). Line 2: 'CERTAIN: ___' (~5in long). Stacked with generous spacing.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P3_LINES at Part 3: instructions ask the child to write 2 predictions. Keywords name the categories.

parts.answer_key: Any 2 predictions matching the categories. Sample: 'POSSIBLE: it will rain. CERTAIN: I will eat lunch.'

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, predict 2 events for tomorrow.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation artifact. Use Part 1 as the formative signal — children who fill in the 'predict' BEFORE the 'result' have grasped the order. Children who fill 'result' first need the 'predict first' re-loop.
